title: Critical Software has the strongest technical bench in Portugal on figures seven years old
content:
Critical Software is a Coimbra University spin-out and carries the strongest technical bench in the Portuguese set. The spin-out origin is a specific kind of signal: the firm was built around technical depth rather than around a delivery contract.

The problem is vintage. The figures behind that assessment are seven years old, dating from 2019, so the bench conclusion rests on a snapshot that predates whatever the firm has become since. A seven-year-old headcount and capability picture is thin ground for a ranking claim, particularly a claim that it leads its market.

The implied action is refresh rather than outreach. The lead sits at priority 4 needing an open-source screen, and the same pass should re-date the underlying figures; its stack was not researched.
